baselineHardGates.label: project host pack certified
baselineHardGates.requirement: project host pack / runtime boundary evidence must be certified before the compiled PageSpec, HiuiLegacyPage runtime, and typed slots stay on the primary chain

baselineHardGates.label: shell ownership stable
baselineHardGates.requirement: shell ownership, runtime owner, PageSpec owner, typed slot owner, and main scroll owner may not drift into the business page

baselineHardGates.label: runtime provenance sealed
baselineHardGates.requirement: src/hiui-runtime core files must match the hiui-design managed runtime seal or an official migration stamp; project-local primitive renderer fallback is not allowed

baselineHardGates.label: canonical shell binding proven
baselineHardGates.requirement: each generated page type must bind the PageSpec canonical shell in the managed runtime, for example table-basic and tree-table bind TablePageFrame instead of local Table/Pagination primitives

baselineHardGates.label: business edits stay in governed slots
baselineHardGates.requirement: business implementation may only fill governed slots and may not synthesize local shell/header/layout owners

conditionalHardGates.label: peer exports resolved

anyOf: project installs a vendored typical-page-shells tarball

conditionalHardGates.requirement: runtime peer dependencies, webpack aliases, and critical exports must resolve from the target project before generation or acceptance can proceed

conditionalHardGates.label: runtime provider adapter governed

anyOf: official shell runtime is blocked in the target dependency graph

conditionalHardGates.requirement: project runtime adapters must live under src/hiui-runtime/adapters/**, consume typed slots, preserve canonical shell semantics, and expose required data-hiui-legacy-region markers

conditionalHardGates.label: header layout proof complete

anyOf: page-level actions owner is PageHeader extra

conditionalHardGates.requirement: headerLayoutContract plus certification / host facts / runtime proof must show PageHeader stretch, right-docked extra, and 60px rhythm owner are unchanged

notes: Baseline hard gates are 6 after runtime provenance and canonical shell binding became mandatory.
When a project declares or vendors @hiui-design/typical-page-shells, the peer-export-resolution conditional gate is added.
When a project replaces the official shell runtime with a governed adapter, the runtime-provider-contract conditional gate is added.
When header is part of the governed page structure, the conditional header gate is added.

Current shipped ordinary typical page molds usually include header and shell runtime imports, so maintainers should expect 8 effective hard gates in standard legacy page plans and 9 when a project runtime adapter is declared.
